battle.name: 第十次「星際大戰」
battle.brief: 705年5月30日，佩滕的多斯皮拉斯以一次「星際大戰」打敗瑪雅大城蒂卡爾，擒其君主、焚其廟碑，令蒂卡爾王統中斷近半個世紀。卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍（khopesh）：青銅時代的單刃彎刀，砍下去不必回抽；它在一千七百年前便已退役，與它血統相通的，是瑪雅那種鑲黑曜石刃、砍下不用拔的棍劍。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 705年5月30日佩滕的這一場衝突，交戰方是兩座古典期瑪雅城邦：勝方多斯皮拉斯（Dos Pilas），敗方蒂卡爾（Tikal）。多斯皮拉斯立於佩滕低地南部，一般研究認為建於629年，由一位出身蒂卡爾王族的女性嫁入卡拉科爾（K'anul，中文亦作卡拉克穆爾）王族後所創，因此常被稱為蒂卡爾分出去、又反過來噬主的「女兒城」。它的軍隊以常備的神聖戰士團（K'uhul，文獻譯作「神將」）為骨幹，配備長矛、投矛器與石鏃、弓箭，以及鑲嵌黑曜石刃的瑪雅棍劍（macuahuitl，通稱馬卡納）；指揮系統由城邦君主（k'uhul ajaw）直接掌握，後方有卡拉科爾的盟軍與佩滕南部的村落網絡作依托。蒂卡爾則是古典期佩滕最大的城邦之一，此時的統治者是伊察克·巴蘭（Yich'aak B'alam），其常備軍同樣以「神將」為核心，加上城民徵召的分隊與擲矛、投石小隊，糧秣由都城四周的田莊供應。兩城的兵源、器械與徵召制度同源，差別在於多斯皮拉斯背後有卡拉科爾的資源，而蒂卡爾當時正處於王位更替之後最脆弱的時候。
countriesEn: The engagement of 30 May 705 in the Petén was fought between two Classic Maya city-states: the victor, Dos Pilas, and the loser, Tikal. Dos Pilas stood in the southern part of the Petén lowlands and is generally held to have been founded in 629 by a woman of Tikal's royal line who married into the ruling house of Caracol (K'anul, also written Caracmul), so it is often described as a daughter city of Tikal that turned back on its mother. Its field army rested on standing bodies of sacred warriors (K'uhul, rendered in the literature as the 'god warriors'), armed with long spears, atlatls with stone points, bows and arrows, and the Maya club-sword (macuahuitl, better known as the macana) inset with obsidian blades. Command sat with the ruler of the city-state (k'uhul ajaw) in person, and behind him stood the allied resources of Caracol together with a network of villages in southern Petén. Tikal was one of the largest city-states of the Classic Petén; it was then ruled by Yich'aak B'alam, and its standing army was likewise built around a K'uhul order, supplemented by conscripted town companies and small units of spear-throwers and slingers, with grain supplied from the milpas around the capital. The two cities raised men and built weapons by the same system; the difference lay in the fact that Dos Pilas could draw on Caracol's resources, while Tikal, freshly through a change of ruler, was at its most exposed.
people: 多斯皮拉斯方面，率軍的是該城君主努恩·烏卓爾·查克（Nuun Ujool Chaak），他在670年代奪取多斯皮拉斯的統治權，把這座原本靠婚姻維繫的附屬城變成自己的基地，隨後以「星際大戰」的方式向蒂卡爾出手。蒂卡爾方面，掌權者是伊察克·巴蘭（Yich'aak B'alam），他與前任君主賈索·錢·卡維爾一世（Jasaw Chan K'awil I）同屬王統一支，據記載在692年前後的一次宮廷變動中取得王位；695年前後攻入卡拉科爾、擒其國君的那次用兵，戰記即記在賈索·錢·卡維爾一世名下，是蒂卡爾反攻的關鍵一役。戰敗之後，蒂卡爾王統流亡，約在711年由基尼奇·雅什·庫克·莫（K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo'）自東方回返重整局面，並在同一年反攻多斯皮拉斯、擒獲努恩·烏卓爾·查克，隨後這位多斯皮拉斯君主便從記載中消失。學術史方面，「星際大戰」這一名稱由銘文學家琳達·謝萊（Linda Schele）提出，指的是那種畫著星宿向下灑落液滴、或星宿覆於貝殼之上的瑪雅字形，其確切讀音與語義至今仍未完全釋讀；主持卡拉科爾考古挖掘的迪安與阿爾倫·蔡斯（Diane and Arlen Chase）則把這類戰爭的物質痕跡與碑銘相互對讀，確認了它不是神話而是史事。
peopleEn: On the Dos Pilas side the army was led by the ruler of that city, Nuun Ujool Chaak, who had seized power there in the 670s and turned a dependency held together by marriage into his own base, and who then struck at Tikal in a 'star war'. On the Tikal side the ruler in power was Yich'aak B'alam, of the same royal line as his predecessor Jasaw Chan K'awil I; the inscriptions record that he took the throne in a palace upheaval around 692, and the campaign of about 695 that struck into Caracol and took its ruler captive is placed in the chronicles under the name of Jasaw Chan K'awil I — it was the key counter-stroke of Tikal's revival. After the defeat the Tikal dynasty went into exile, and around 711 K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' returned from the east to restore the ruling line, in the same year striking back at Dos Pilas and taking Nuun Ujool Chaak prisoner, after which the Dos Pilas ruler disappears from the record. In the history of scholarship the term 'star war' was coined by the epigrapher Linda Schele for the Maya glyph that shows a celestial body pouring liquid droplets over the earth, or a star set above a shell; its exact phonetic value and meaning have still not been fully deciphered. Diane and Arlen Chase, who directed the archaeological excavation of Caracol, were the ones who matched the material traces of this class of conflict against the inscriptions and confirmed that it was history rather than myth.
kits: 任務單上這件兵器是埃及月牙劍（khopesh）：青銅時代的單刃彎刀，刃口開在內弧，砍下去不必回抽，到705年它早已退役約兩千二百年，考古上只在古埃及的墓葬與儀式場面中作為遺物出現，它並不出現在705年的佩滕戰場。真正可以同它對位的，是中美洲那種「砍下去不用拔」的單刃兵器——瑪雅棍劍 macuahuitl（通稱馬卡納）：以硬木為柄，刃面嵌入黑曜石與燧石碎片，一次揮擊即完成切割，同樣不必把刀拔出再來一次。月牙劍的造型邏輯（月弧、單刃、以劈砍而非刺擊取勝）在技術史上與瑪雅棍劍同屬「弧刃家族」，差別在一者用青銅、一者用天然玻璃質黑曜石；同一時期的東地中海與伊朗高原，早就把月牙劍的血統改造成更長更彎的刀式。除棍劍外，多斯皮拉斯與蒂卡爾兩軍還有投矛器與石鏃、長矛、弓與箭、小型圓盾與獸皮覆盾，以及以棉花絮製的軟甲，這些都屬於古典期瑪雅城邦的常備配置。至於傳說中與月牙劍同源的沙姆希爾式彎刀，在705年已是中亞與伊朗的現役兵器，並沒有出現在佩滕。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh: a single-edged bronze sickle sword whose cutting edge lies on the inside of the curve, so that a stroke does not have to be drawn back. By 705 it had been out of service for roughly two thousand two hundred years and survives archaeologically only as an heirloom in Egyptian burials and ritual scenes; it was certainly not present on any Petén battlefield. What can be set against it functionally is the Mesoamerican one-edged weapon that also cuts without needing to be pulled back: the Maya club-sword, the macuahuitl, better known as the macana, a hardwood haft into which obsidian and chert blades are set, so that a single swing completes the cut. The design logic of the khopesh — the curve, the single edge, victory by the chop rather than by the thrust — places it and the Maya macuahuitl in the same family of curved blades, the difference being bronze in one case and natural volcanic glass in the other; in the eastern Mediterranean and on the Iranian plateau the khopesh lineage had by 705 already been carried over into the longer, more curved sabre form. Alongside the club-sword, the armies of Dos Pilas and Tikal also used atlatls with stone points, long spears, bows and arrows, small round shields and hide-covered shields, and quilted soft armour of cotton; all of these belonged to the standing equipment of the Classic Maya city-states. The sabre of the shamshir family, descended from the same blood as the khopesh, was by 705 already in service in Central Asia and Iran and did not appear in the Petén.
tactics: 「星際大戰」在銘文學上的定義不是兩軍對撞的會戰，而是一場以奪取對方君主、摧毀其祭祀中心為目的的決定性襲擊。多斯皮拉斯的做法是：趁季候轉換、驛路可通的窗口，率精銳自西南方向插入佩滕中部，先拔蒂卡爾的依附城與外圍哨點，再直入城中，擒住君主、焚毀石碑與廟宇，把原屬蒂卡爾的勢力範圍重新切走。瑪雅人沒有馱獸，也沒有車隊，糧秣、箭矢與黑曜石刃全靠人背，隊伍在雨林小徑上行進的速度遠低於開闊地上的騎兵，因此這類突擊必須靠出其不意取勝，而不是靠正面消耗。季節規律也支持這種做法：學者統計，碑銘記載的星際大戰多集中在十一月到翌年一月的乾季，落在九月半至十月下旬的收穫季則一次都沒有；而705年5月30日這場正處於雨季將盡、黏土路基稍可通行的時節，是少數不符合乾季聚集規律的例子，顯示這次行動的時間選擇更可能出自局勢，而不是例行的天象儀式。
tacticsEn: In epigraphic terms a 'star war' is not a set-piece collision between two armies but a decisive raid aimed at capturing the opposing ruler and destroying his ceremonial centre. Dos Pilas proceeded by taking advantage of the turn of the season, when the causeways and forest tracks could be used, and driving an elite force in from the south-west into central Petén: first cutting off Tikal's dependent towns and outlying watch-posts, and then pushing into the city itself, seizing the ruler, burning the stelae and the temples, and re-cutting away the sphere of influence that had belonged to Tikal. The Maya had no beasts of burden and no wagon trains; grain, arrows and obsidian blades all went on human backs, and a column moving on rainforest trails travelled far more slowly than mounted troops on open ground, so such an attack had to win by surprise rather than by attrition. The seasonal pattern supports the method: scholars note that the star wars recorded in the inscriptions cluster in the dry season from November to January, and that not one is recorded in the harvest season between mid-September and late October. The war of 30 May 705 falls at the end of the rainy season, when the clay roads had become just passable; it is one of the few cases that does not follow the dry-season concentration, which suggests that its timing was driven by circumstance rather than by the regular astronomical ritual.
data: 可核對的硬數字有幾組。第一，日期：705年5月30日，瑪雅長曆9.13.13.7.2，是有銘文可考的「星際大戰」之一，在全部記載中序第十；若連同562至781年之間的同類事件一併計，碑銘可考的星際大戰至少十三次。第二，天象：統計顯示，記錄在案的星際大戰日期有七成對應金星的可見相位，其中八成四又對應昏星的第一次出現；德雷斯頓抄本的金星表把金星畫成從天頂以槍刺人，瑪雅人稱金星為「偉大之星」（Chak Ek'），視之為戰爭的引信。第三，後果對照：562年卡拉科爾打敗蒂卡爾後，蒂卡爾人口衰退、停建紀念碑，歷時一百二十年；631年卡拉克穆爾在12月25日打敗納蘭霍後，納蘭霍的君主受刑而死，甚至傳說被食用；669年的托爾圖吉耶羅碑刻寫著「血聚成池，頭骨堆成堆」。第四，705年這場星際大戰本身沒有留下可靠的殘傷數字，流傳下來的主要是物證式的說法：蒂卡爾的祭祀區在隨後數十年出現廢棄與焚燒痕跡，而城市在約半個世紀裡沒有新的紀念碑。
dataEn: There are several sets of figures that can be checked. First, the date: 30 May 705, Maya Long Count 9.13.13.7.2, one of the attested 'star wars', tenth in order among the recorded cases; counting the other events of the same kind between 562 and 781, at least thirteen star wars are known from inscriptions. Second, the astronomy: statistically, about seventy per cent of the recorded star-war dates correspond to a visible phase of Venus, and eighty-four per cent of those correspond to the first appearance of the evening star; the Venus tables of the Dresden Codex show the planet spearing people as it passes overhead, and the Maya called Venus the 'Great Star' (Chak Ek'), holding it to be the trigger of war. Third, the consequences, for comparison: after Caracol beat Tikal in 562, Tikal's population declined, monument building stopped, and the hiatus lasted a hundred and twenty years; on 25 December 631 Calakmul beat Naranjo, whose ruler was put to death by torture and, according to the account, possibly eaten; a Tortuguero monument of 669 records that 'the blood was pooled, the skulls were piled'. Fourth, the war of 705 itself left no reliable casualty figures; what survives is material rather than numerical: the ceremonial precinct at Tikal shows abandonment and burning in the decades that followed, and for roughly half a century the city raised no new monuments.
cause: 衝突不是一天長出來的。蒂卡爾在562年被卡拉科爾打成重創後沉寂了一百二十年，直到七世紀初重新坐大，以神聖君主的身份在佩滕爭奪霸權。682年即位的賈索·錢·卡維爾一世把這條上升線推到頂點，695年前後蒂卡爾反手攻入卡拉科爾、擒其國君，等於直接挑戰卡拉科爾的盟權。卡拉科爾的回應不是親自出兵，而是扶植它的「女兒城」多斯皮拉斯——629年由蒂卡爾王族女性與卡拉科爾王族通婚所立、原本用來牽制母邦的據點。多斯皮拉斯在670年一度打敗蒂卡爾，672年又被蒂卡爾反打回去；此後十餘年，兩城的裂痕在王位更替與外患之間越拉越大。705年的星際大戰就是這條裂痕的最終爆開：對多斯皮拉斯而言，是趁蒂卡爾新君立足未穩而一舉雪恥；對蒂卡爾而言，則是致命的一擊。
causeEn: The conflict did not grow up in a day. Tikal was badly hit by Caracol in 562 and lay still for a hundred and twenty years, until it reasserted itself in the early seventh century and contested hegemony in the Petén as a city ruled by a divine king. Jasaw Chan K'awil I, who took the throne in 682, pushed that rising line to its height, and around 695 Tikal struck into Caracol and took its ruler prisoner, which was a direct challenge to Caracol's alliance system. Caracol's answer was not to campaign in person but to build on its 'daughter city' Dos Pilas, founded in 629 by the marriage of a woman of Tikal's royal line into the house of Caracol and originally maintained precisely as a thorn in the side of the mother city. Dos Pilas beat Tikal in 670 and was beaten back by Tikal in 672; over the following decade the rift between the two cities widened under the pressure of changes of ruler and of external attack. The star war of 705 was that rift finally bursting open: for Dos Pilas, a chance to wipe out the insult while Tikal's new ruler was not yet secure; for Tikal, a fatal blow.
impact: 705年之後，古典期蒂卡爾的政權結構實際上中斷了。君主被擒、廟宇被焚、碑刻停建，城市在約半個世紀裡幾乎從地圖上消失，留下的是被掩埋的廢墟與殘缺的身分牌；直到約711年，流亡海外的基尼奇·雅什·庫克·莫帶著王統回到蒂卡爾，才重新立起石碑，此後蒂卡爾又用了一個多世紀才在佩滕重建霸權，並於744年反過來攻入卡拉科爾、奪走對方的守護神像，把562與705年兩次加在自己頭上的屈辱做了一次儀式上的回敬。同一套戰爭邏輯也把多斯皮拉斯推向自己的結局：711年被蒂卡爾反攻擒獲的努恩·烏卓爾·查克此後再無記錄，多斯皮拉斯在760年代前後被放棄，佩滕的低地世界進入更碎裂的時代。從學術上看，705年這次星際大戰是「星際大戰」這一類別中最能說明後果的一例，也是後來學者把銘文、陵墓與地層三者對讀、重建古典期佩滕政治版圖的關鍵節點。
impactEn: After 705 the political structure of Classic Tikal was effectively interrupted. Its ruler was taken, its temples burned, its stelae no longer raised; the city practically disappeared from the map for about half a century, leaving buried ruins and broken identity plaques behind. Only around 711, when K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' returned to Tikal from exile with the ruling line, were stelae set up again, and Tikal then needed more than a century to rebuild its hegemony in the Petén — and in 744 it struck back into Caracol and carried off that city's patron deity image, ritually repaying the humiliation inflicted on it in 562 and in 705. The same logic of war carried Dos Pilas to its own end: Nuun Ujool Chaak, captured by Tikal's counter-attack around 711, disappears from the record, and Dos Pilas was abandoned around the 760s, leaving the lowland Petén world more fragmented than before. Scholarly, the star war of 705 is one of the clearest demonstrations of what this class of conflict cost, and a key point for the later work of reading inscriptions, burials and stratigraphy together to reconstruct the political map of the Classic Petén.
result: 結局直接而殘酷：705年5月30日，多斯皮拉斯在長曆9.13.13.7.2那一天打敗蒂卡爾，成為有銘文記錄的第十次星際大戰。蒂卡爾的君主與祭祀中心同時陷落，佔據該城近半世紀的蒂卡爾王統就此中斷，城市被燒成廢墟，居民四散；有記載把擒獲蒂卡爾君主伊察克·巴蘭本人一事放在705年之後數年（約708年），可視為這場襲擊的最後一步。戰役的直接贏家多斯皮拉斯只領先了六年，便在約711年被蒂卡爾的反攻擊潰，努恩·烏卓爾·查克被擒，隨後多斯皮拉斯在760年代前後被永久放棄。705年這一役因此留下雙向的結局：它既是古典期佩滕最大城邦的一次崩解，也是「星際大戰」這種決定性襲擊在整個古典期政治中代價最高的一次實踐。
resultEn: The outcome was direct and brutal: on 30 May 705, Dos Pilas defeated Tikal on the day the Long Count records as 9.13.13.7.2, and it was the tenth star war known from inscriptions. Tikal's ruler and its ceremonial centre fell together, the dynasty that had held the city for close to half a century was interrupted, the city was burned into ruins and its people scattered; the accounts place the taking of Tikal's ruler Yich'aak B'alam himself a few years after 705, around 708, and it can be read as the last step of the same raid. The direct winner led for only six years: around 711 Tikal's counter-attack broke him, Nuun Ujool Chaak was taken prisoner, and Dos Pilas itself was permanently abandoned around the 760s. The war of 705 therefore carries a double ending — it was at once the collapse of the largest city-state of the Classic Petén, and the most costly practical demonstration, across the whole of the Classic period, of what a 'star war' could do.
